name: get_calendar_context
description: This tool belongs to the PersonalCalendarAPI, which provides functionality for managing calendar events, scheduling, and attendee coordination. Tool description: Get the current calendar context including the simulated current date.

total_events.description: Total number of events in the calendar.

name: create_event
description: This tool belongs to the PersonalCalendarAPI, which provides functionality for managing calendar events, scheduling, and attendee coordination. Tool description: Create a new calendar event.

start_time.description: Start time of the event (format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM').

end_time.description: End time of the event (format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM').

name: get_events
description: This tool belongs to the PersonalCalendarAPI, which provides functionality for managing calendar events, scheduling, and attendee coordination. Tool description: Get all events for a specific date.

events.description: List of events on the given date.

name: get_events_range
description: This tool belongs to the PersonalCalendarAPI, which provides functionality for managing calendar events, scheduling, and attendee coordination. Tool description: Get all events within a date range.

events.description: List of events within the date range.

name: delete_event
description: This tool belongs to the PersonalCalendarAPI, which provides functionality for managing calendar events, scheduling, and attendee coordination. Tool description: Delete a calendar event.

event_id.description: ID of the event to delete.

delete_status.description: True if the event was successfully deleted.

name: get_event_details
description: This tool belongs to the PersonalCalendarAPI, which provides functionality for managing calendar events, scheduling, and attendee coordination. Tool description: Get details of a specific event.

event_id.description: ID of the event to retrieve.

name: update_event
description: This tool belongs to the PersonalCalendarAPI, which provides functionality for managing calendar events, scheduling, and attendee coordination. Tool description: Update an existing calendar event.

event_id.description: ID of the event to update.

updates.description: Dictionary of fields to update (e.g., title, location, description).

name: add_attendee
description: This tool belongs to the PersonalCalendarAPI, which provides functionality for managing calendar events, scheduling, and attendee coordination. Tool description: Add an attendee to a calendar event.

attendee.description: Username of the attendee to add.

attendee_added.description: True if the attendee was added successfully.

name: find_free_slots
description: This tool belongs to the PersonalCalendarAPI, which provides functionality for managing calendar events, scheduling, and attendee coordination. Tool description: Find free time slots on a given date.

date.description: Date to find free slots for (format: 'YYYY-MM-DD').

free_slots.description: List of free time slots, each with 'start' and 'end' times.

start.description: Start time of the free slot.

end.description: End time of the free slot.
